betCard.$description: The betslip selection card — one bet (event + market + outcome + odds), the core repeating block of the betslip. Two densities share one anatomy: `compact` (Combo/System — odds sits inline to the right of the outcome, no stake field) and `amount` (Single — a Bet-amount field to the right of the outcome column). Header and market are identical across both; the outcome differs (see outcome). Sits directly on the page (surface.page), one elevation up (surface.raised = surface-4), NO border — the surface step alone separates it, unlike Card's hairline. Radius/padding/rhythm per Figma spec (radius.md, 8px padding, 8/4 vertical rhythm). Odds movement colours (up/down/changed) and the LIVE/FB/BB badges and suspended/error states are deliberately OUT of this first pass — they become the separate Odds component + Badge variants + card states.

radius.$description: 12px — a touch rounder than the 8px go-to (Card/Button), matching the betslip cards' softer corner.

bg.$description: surface-4 — one elevation above the page (surface.page); no border, the surface step alone lifts the card.

padding.$description: 8px inner padding (Figma spec) — 20px sport icon / × sit flush 8px from the card edges.

gap.$description: 8px between the leading icon, event link and remove ×.

color.$description: Muted grey — chrome icon, not content.

type.$description: 12px underlined link — the event is tappable (opens the event page); truncates with ellipsis.

color.$description: Secondary grey; the outcome below is the emphasised line, not the event name.

hoverColor.$description: Turns the active colour on hover — the link is a tap target (opens the event).

box.$description: 20px — the × is a ghost icon button, same 20px footprint as the sport icon, flush 8px from the card edge.

radius.$description: 6px — subtle rounding on the hover square.

hoverFill.$description: The ghost Button's hover fill (fill.neutralHover) — this × IS a ghost icon button, so it reuses the ghost hover, not a bespoke overlay.

type.$description: 12px regular — the market name (e.g. 'Match Winner'), muted; truncates.

gap.$description: 8px between the settlement-rules info icon and the market name.

color.$description: Gold/warning — flags a market with special settlement rules; tapping opens the rich tooltip. Plain markets have no info icon.

outcome.$description: The selected outcome. Density-specific weight: in `compact` (Combo/System) it is the emphasised line — 14px semibold (heading-base); in `amount` (Single) the odds is the emphasised value instead, so the outcome steps down to 12px regular (body-sm) but stays white (text.default), not muted.

singleType.$description: 12px regular (body-sm), white — Single density, where the odds carries the emphasis.

type.$description: 14px semibold (heading-base), tabular-nums — the odds value, in both densities. This first pass is the static value only; movement (up/down/changed, struck-through old value) becomes the separate Odds component and recolours to text.positive/text.negative there.

amount.$description: The per-selection Bet-amount field (Single/`amount` density only) IS the Input component — the lg (48px) floating-label variant with a currency prefix. It is NOT restyled here: its height, radius, paddings, the 10px floating label, the 16px REGULAR value, the '$' prefix (input.prefix), the surface.page fill + outline.strong border and the outline.active focus border are all resolved from tokens/components/input.tokens.json at build time, so a bet-card stake field and a standalone Input stay identical (same regular 16px value — not a bespoke semibold). The only bet-card-specific bits are the fixed width and that the field is bottom-aligned to the outcome column, not stretched to the market+outcome+odds height.

width.$description: 160px fixed — a column of Single cards lines up.

betbuilder.$description: Betbuilder density — one 'bet' that is itself a bundle of same-event legs (a same-game multi). The header (sport icon · event · ×) and the footer (Betbuilder Odd + stake field, the Input component) are the bet-card's own; the middle is an INSET darker card (surface.card = surface-2, one step below the surface-4 outer) listing each leg as an outcome-over-market row (outcome above, 4px, market below — the inverse of the compact density) with its own remove ×, split by hairline dividers. Outcome/market reuse the shared outcome/market roles; odds value + the stake field reuse odds/amount. Badges (BB/LIVE) and odds movement are OUT of this pass (badges are being reworked first, then added to every bet card).

innerBg.$description: surface-2 — the inset legs card, one step DARKER than the surface-4 outer, so the leg list reads as recessed into the bet.

rowPaddingX.$description: 8px — leg content sits 8px from the inset card's side edges (and its top/bottom edges via the first/last row's padding).

rowGap.$description: 4px between a leg's outcome and its market line.

divider.$description: Hairline between leg rows — outline.default (surface-4) reads as a subtle lighter line on the surface-2 inset.
